name: synchroflow-monorepo
description: The root of the SynchroFlow monorepo.

scripts.build: npm run build:modules && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:deps: npx tsc -p modules/shared/tsconfig.build.json && npm --workspace ./modules/specter run build && npm --workspace ./modules/alerts run build && npm --workspace ./modules/cashflow run build && npm --workspace ./modules/demand run build && npm --workspace ./modules/fulfillment run build && npm --workspace ./modules/returns run build && npm --workspace ./modules/problem-center run build && npm --workspace ./modules/suppliers-portal run build && npm --workspace ./modules/floor-planning run build
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:deps && npm --workspace ./apps/backend run build
scripts.build:modules: npm --workspace modules/customers run build && npm --workspace modules/finances run build && npm --workspace modules/order-nexus run build && npm --workspace modules/products run build && npm --workspace modules/overview run build && npm --workspace modules/alerts run build && npm --workspace modules/cashflow run build && npm --workspace modules/fulfillment run build && npm --workspace modules/returns run build && npm --workspace ./modules/problem-center run build
scripts.build:apps: npm --workspace ui run build && npm --workspace api run build
scripts.dev-worker: wait-on tcp:5432 && SKIP_DEPS=1 npm run dev:worker --workspace=api
scripts.db:reset: docker exec synchroflow_db psql -U sf_user -d postgres -c 'DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS synchroflow_db;' && docker exec synchroflow_db psql -U sf_user -d postgres -c 'CREATE DATABASE synchroflow_db;'
scripts.dev:full-reset: npm run db:reset && npm run migrate --workspace ./apps/backend && DEV_SEED_MODE=full_identity npm run seed --workspace ./apps/backend && echo '✅ Migration + seed complete — starting dev servers...' && npm run dev
scripts.dev:setup: npm run db:reset && npm run migrate --workspace ./apps/backend && npm run seed --workspace ./apps/backend
scripts.test:setup: npm run db:reset && NODE_ENV=test npm run migrate --workspace ./apps/backend && DEV_SEED_MODE=full_identity NODE_ENV=test npm run seed --workspace ./apps/backend
